purpose: Non-claim-bearing scratch artifacts are parked HERE, never in a claim-bearing results tree.
why: Audit CYCLE_39199651952 F-6 (advisory). results/evaluation/retrieval_counter_authority_benchmark/ carried pytest_local*.json and test_resume*.json, which are unit-test / local-poke runs wearing run-id-shaped filenames. They are exactly the leak the SCRATCH-RUN OBLIGATION documented at evaluation/benchmark_retrieval_counter_authority.py:47-55 was written to prevent, because the workflow's `git add -A` persist step promotes whatever is in the tree into the accepted snapshot.
what_was_NOT_done: No file was deleted and no byte was altered. Every moved file is preserved verbatim under results/evaluation/_scratch_namespaced/retrieval_counter_authority_benchmark/ and reports/evaluation/_scratch_namespaced/, so a contrary or negative observation is still readable.
standing_rule: A scratch invocation of any lane instrument MUST pass --out-dir / --report-dir pointing at a scratch path. A claim-bearing invocation writes the committed default and is named for the real GITHUB_RUN_ID. Never reuse an existing run id.
evidence_class: These eight records are NOT evidence for any claim. Their verdicts (BENCHMARK_VALID_NO_FALSIFICATION, exit 0) are not cited anywhere in reports/evaluation/ or state/evaluation.json.
